description.value: Edo Japan Courtenay Crossing is a Japanese-inspired fast-casual franchise in the Courtenay Crossing strip mall on Cliffe Avenue, serving teppanyaki grilled meals, hand-rolled sushi, ramen, and bubble tea. Founded in Calgary in 1979, it is one of Canada's largest teriyaki chains with over 200 locations nationwide. Touring cyclists will find a full dine-in room alongside takeout and delivery options.
